**MATERIALS ENGINEER (NEW GRAD DECEMBER 2026\)**
 Freeform builds AI\-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial\-scale parts at the speed of human ideation.  As a Materials Engineer at Freeform, you will support the company's M\&P infrastructure, strategy, and best practices for our advanced metal 3D printing technology. You will work alongside senior engineers to conduct hands on sample testing, analyze findings, and contribute to strategic process improvements. This is a unique opportunity to build a fundamental understanding of metals characterization and processing while working at the cutting edge of additive manufacturing.
